Current accessible public proof with distinct purpose and clear titles; no stale or redundant destinations.
Intentional positioning or relevant visual with readable crop, contrast and no confidential detail.
Chosen representation is clear at displayed size and professionally appropriate to the user; no attractiveness or identity judgments.
Accurate current status/dates, clear scope and supported contributions/outcomes; unemployment or a transition is not inherently a deficit.
Relevant roles/projects give sufficient evidence and contribution credit, with coherent chronology.
Priority skills fit documented ability and the target work; no invented endorsements.
Authentic relevant third-party evidence describes work or contribution; no fabricated endorsements or rigid recency quota.
Available activity supports intended professional identity and is accurately attributed; judge relevance, not a compulsory posting streak.
User-chosen public contact and profile links work and are appropriately private.
